radiology_report:
Jeroen Bosch Ziekenhuis ('s-Hertogenbosch)
Imaging Department
Date: 14 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI Prostate

Clinical indication: Elevated PSA 6.0 ng/mL. Prior biopsy Gleason 3+3 (ISUP GG1).

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume 49.0 mL. Peripheral zone contains a 9 mm lesion in the left posterior midgland region. On T2WI the focus appears mildly hypointense without clear capsular bulging. Diffusion-weighted imaging shows restricted diffusion with low ADC values relative to the contralateral peripheral zone. Dynamic contrast enhancement demonstrates early focal uptake. Transition zone is unremarkable. No extracapsular extension, seminal vesicle invasion or suspicious lymphadenopathy is identified.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 3 lesion (left posterior midgland, ~9 mm). Prostate volume 49.0 mL; PSA density 0.13 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.7948016.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (Aug 2022): The submitted prostate tissue demonstrates adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. A cribriform pattern is present within the malignant glands.

Biopsy 2 (Feb 2025): The most recent prostate tissue again shows adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+3, reported as ISUP grade group 1. A cribriform pattern is present.

Summary: The histological trajectory across timepoints is stable with persistent ISUP grade group 1 disease, although the presence of cribriform architecture is noted at both timepoints.
